title: Installing Hauppauge WinTV-HVR-1800 on a Linux Server
content: Installing Hauppauge WinTV-HVR-1800 on a Linux Server to stream channels to Jellyfin.

title: Getting Started
content: Install the card into an available PCI slot on the server

title: Hardware Installation
content:
Boot the server, open a Terminal and run:


lspci | grep -i hauppauge

You should see output similar to Multimedia video controller: Hauppauge device 8880 (rev xx)

title: Load the correct kernel modules
content:
Check that the driver is loaded:


lsmod | grep cx23885

If not then load it:

sudo modprobe cx23885

title: Install TVHeadend
content:
sudo apt install tvheadend

Test capture

ffmpeg -f video4linux2 -i /dev/video0 -t 10 output.mpg

Go to:

http://[your-server-ip]:9981

title: Connect to Jellyfin
content:
Go to Dashboard > Live TV > Add tuner device.


Choose TVHeadend as the device type.


Set URL to:


http://[your-tvheadend-ip]:9981
